integration_notes: Run xcodegen: the new Swift files are not in project.pbxproj yet (not regenerated by me). Salini/** sources already include ios/Salini/EssenceAssets/*.png as bundle resources (flat); lookup also checks an «EssenceAssets» subfolder.
Replace MaterialFeatureView(open:) with EssenceFeatureView(open:) on Home; same callback signature.

Activation: feature.active = false at creation; in the scroll delegate set active = viewport.intersects(feature.convert(feature.animationBounds, to: scrollView)). The view also pauses itself off-window, in background and with Reduce Motion.

Layout: give the feature full column width; fragments fly only inside the stage (84 pt above the card, card full width). No clipping on the stage; keep clipsToBounds=false on its ancestors up to the column.

art_pipeline.manifest: Built-in EssenceLayers.fallbackManifest names the six brief assets; a bundled EssenceLayers.json ([EssenceLayer], same fields) overrides positions/sizes/labels without code changes.
art_pipeline.layer_fields: x,y,width in card units (y<0 above the card), rotation; backX/backY/backWidth/backRotation = pose when the other material is chosen; closedDX/closedDY/closedRotation = assembled offset (loose piece rejoins its body before the opening); depth (parallax/float), z, lift (contact shadow), labels [{key: stone|core|coat, x, y in image 0…1, above}]
art_pipeline.variants: finishImages {senseMatte, senseGloss} cross-fade on selection (matching asset per finish). Missing images: layer skipped; missing variant falls back to one present; no image at all → procedural fallback stage.
art_pipeline.no_stretch: each image keeps its own aspect ratio (height = width × aspect); alpha preserved; no masks on image layers

motion.opening: 0.3 s hold, then 2.0 s smootherstep: loose pieces part from their bodies
motion.focus: selecting a finish moves the chosen material's layers to their hero pose and the other to its back pose (critically damped, ~0.7 s); S-Sense matte/gloss cross-fade 0.45 s
motion.float: slow sine float/sway scaled by depth; scroll parallax by the stage's window position (±14 pt × depth)
motion.lifecycle: CADisplayLink (30–60 Hz) only while active, in a window, foreground and Reduce Motion off; weak ticker; static settled pose otherwise
motion.reduce_motion: opened, focused composition, no float; measured 0.0 % changed pixels over 3 s
